params.linkText: approval to dual-list its common stock

children: on Nasdaq Texas. Trading on the Nasdaq Texas venue is scheduled to begin at the market open on or about September 23, 2026.
The company's common stock will continue to trade on its primary exchange, the Nasdaq Global Market, under the ticker symbol "NUTX."
The dual listing requires no action from existing shareholders, and all common shares will remain fully fungible across both venues.
Headquartered in the Houston metropolitan area, Nutex Health operates 28 hospital facilities across 12 states alongside a primary care-centric, risk-bearing physician network.
